about: Each town's trade (Docs/Design/61-industry-of-the-realm.md): the goods it is known for and sends out, and what it needs from elsewhere (needs: told, not enforced). A town's producers of its goods (farms, mines, fisheries...) bring in `yield` times as much of them, and keep `keep` times as much in store to send; when a town needs a good, the roads buy it first from a town whose trade it is, if that town has any to spare. Towns are the game's communities (region ids). Numbers are placeholders.

towns.trade: iron: ore from its mines and bars from its smelter; charcoal and furs
the lake's fish, fresh and smoked; flour from its mill; horses
timber, planks and charcoal from the warm forest; joinery; pork; herbs
clay and sand, bricks and tiles from the Clayholt works; reeds and eels from the fens
the granary of the downs: grain and flour, milk, cheese and butter, wool, mutton and hides
cider and wine, apples, honey and beeswax, and the south's grain
the city's industry: building materials (House Greatly), timber and woodwork (Fell), iron and steel (Grayrock), wool, cloth and leather (Mossgrave); salt, glass, paper and rope
